title: Saudi Arabia Appears to Be Preparing for a New War With the Houthis
summary: Analysts say that weeks of Houthi attacks on Saudi targets have brought the kingdom and the Iranian-backed militia to the brink of full-blown conflict, and could open a new front in the Iran war.
